Music Nerd · issue #1424 · actual saved renderer output

What the two versions answered in iteration 2.

This offline report shows saved answers and grades for separately labeled transfer and development cohorts, including writer-only and joined-lane observations. Answer paragraphs come from the saved chat renderer; fictional originals are reproduced in full. Authentication and storage paths were fixture-backed, so this report does not establish deployed integration behavior.

Mixed result: 3 candidate wins and 1 tie on four previously seen development cases. On six fresh transfer cases: 0 candidate wins, 1 baseline win, 4 ties and 1 incomparable pair. Keep the draft on hold for owner review; the fresh archive-detail regression remains unresolved.
Findings
  • Baseline research logic: 3d344d919ef21d783f37c4e97cbd24efcf9f159c. Candidate: 49f8eef013e397cba44cfed9b878e4a3010f0347. All 10 pairs and 20 displayed responses are retained: 17 sourced answers and 3 safe clarifications.
  • Fresh transfer strict criteria, unchanged: baseline 4 pass / 1 nonpass / 1 not established; candidate 3 pass / 2 nonpass / 1 not established. T05 is a candidate regression: it explains the damaged label and empty surviving credits, but omits the lost second-label/ledger part of the record gap. No fabrication was observed in the blind review.
  • Development strict criteria, unchanged: baseline 0 pass / 3 nonpass / 1 not established; candidate 1 pass / 1 nonpass / 2 not established. Answer-quality preferences favor the candidate on H05 namesake disambiguation, H11 distinct unidentified voices, and H12 redundant uncertainty. H07 is a quality tie: candidate retains the general-thanks distinction but omits Opal Switch’s producer name; baseline does the reverse. Both satisfy the core requested roles and both retain their frozen strict omissions.
  • T02 returned the identical request-limit clarification in both versions, without API dispatch or original reads. H05 baseline also clarified. These are noncompletions, not successful research answers. The 160-character limit was preserved.
  • Independent routing audit: T01’s private working label did not enter either API wire request. H05 candidate carried Bellwater trio in both publicSubject and the existing publicConstraints and then into the API topic; it read the supplied namesake and trio originals. Preservation cannot be attributed solely to the new field. Answer-only routing/capability grades remain locked as not established, with this separate trace evidence reported alongside them.
  • No observed case used the coverage-driven repair retry. H12 candidate’s first writer output already had unanswered=null; its complete checker result did not visibly clear an existing notice. The host repair/clearing paths have deterministic red/green integration evidence, but no isolated live causal demonstration in this run.
  • Prior 16-pair reports and all original scores remain unchanged. This one bounded iteration ended after the frozen comparison; no outcome was regenerated, no rubric weakened, and no production release or issue closure was performed.
Accounting
  • Current iteration: $0.20345875, all 40 calls accounted (6 planner, 17 writer, 17 checker). Transfer: $0.11938425; development: $0.08407450. No generation retry, repair loop, outstanding request, or new uncertainty.
  • Previous comparison cycle: $0.33818650. Earlier targeted run: $0.03930810. Original historical accounted batch: $0.13905275. Previous confirmed total: $0.51654735.
  • All-history confirmed spend: $0.72000610 across 177 accounted calls. Separate old unresolved reservation: $0.02734200, not confirmed spend. Combined exposure: $0.74734810 against the $10 ceiling; remaining exposure room $9.25265190. The ephemeral evaluation token was removed after completion.
Limits
  • Six newly authored synthetic transfer cases and four previously seen development cases are separate cohorts. New cases and rubric were sealed before candidate evaluation. The author did not inspect the new implementation or previous outputs for this task but had prior case-authoring exposure. These are not independently human-annotated benchmark results.
  • A/B assignments and presentation order were independently randomized from a private pre-run seed. Grades were locked before unmasking. The reviewer had earlier implementation/control and prior-fixture exposure; masking cannot eliminate expectation bias. One observation per arm is not causal proof or a general quality estimate.
  • Joined observations use real Web planner/handler/HTTP adapter and real API validation/selection/windowing with fixture authentication, storage, admission/leases and queue/status. No deployed database, durable worker, live source collection, ownership verification or production behavior is established.
  • Identity extraction and checker coverage are model judgments. The host preserves declared public qualifiers but cannot guarantee the model declares every qualifier or excludes every private detail. The observed T05 omission passed the candidate checker as complete. Stronger completeness guarantees would require a separate trusted intent/coverage design; none was added in this iteration.
  • Equivalent provider settings were verified across both arms: Google Gemini 3.8 Flash, low thinking and temperature 0 for planning; Anthropic Claude Sonnet 5.5, low effort and default temperature for drafting/checking. Limits remained 2,400/2,400/1,500 output tokens. No fallback provider or billable web search occurred.
  • Application deadlines and allowed calls were unchanged. Billing visibility waits added 620,458 ms to the evaluation and were excluded from application deadlines; this run does not establish end-user latency improvements. Opening this static report makes no model/provider calls.

baseline: answered · patch: answered

Baseline · 3d344d91

The public catalog entry for “Tide Window” prints the performer name as Nevi Sorn. 1 The entry says the performer field reproduces the public release credit and does not state a civil or legal identity. 1

Candidate · 49f8eef0

The public catalog entry for “Tide Window” lists the performing artist as Nevi Sorn. 1 That name reproduces the public release credit, and the entry does not state a civil or legal identity. 1

Tie · Equivalent direct, cited public-credit answers. Neither infers a civil identity or repeats private setup. Answer requirements pass; actual lookup routing and exclusion of private history from dispatch cannot be established from these display blocks.

Neither voice can be identified as Sela Morn from this transcript, since it has no speaker roster, identity key, or ownership record linking either voice to anyone. 1 The transcript only labels the two voices as Voice A and Voice B. 1

Neither voice can be identified as Sela Morn from this transcript, because it has no speaker roster, identity key, or ownership record linking either voice to them or anyone else. 1 The transcript only labels two distinct voices as Voice A and Voice B, and keeps those labels without naming anyone. 1

Tie · Both directly state that neither labeled voice can be identified as Sela Morn and explain the missing identity/ownership evidence. Minor wording differences do not warrant a quality preference.

Who mastered “Morrow Glass”?

baseline: answered · patch: answered

Baseline · 3d344d91

The archive note says no mastering name for “Morrow Glass” can be recovered, because the only lacquer label was heat-damaged and hid its credit line. 1 The surviving sleeve and invoice have no mastering credit, and the second label and matching ledger were lost. 1

Candidate · 49f8eef0

The archive note says no mastering name for “Morrow Glass” can be recovered, so the mastering engineer isn't known from these sources. 1 The credit is missing because the only lacquer label was heat-damaged, and the surviving sleeve and invoice carry no mastering credit. 1

Baseline · Both give a useful, grounded archival limitation without a generic uncertainty suffix. Baseline more completely explains the frozen missing-label and missing-copy criterion by naming the lost second label and ledger. Candidate explains damage and empty surviving credits but leaves the missing-copy part implicit. This is a narrow completeness difference, not fabrication or a requirement to enumerate every possible archive item.

Did Pax Cedar produce the Bellwater trio Oriel Loom’s 2022 album Folded Coast?

baseline: answer_from_initial_response · patch: answered

Baseline · 3d344d91

Could you narrow this to one public research question? I couldn't preserve all its constraints within the request limit.

Candidate · 49f8eef0

The supplied sources don't say Pax Cedar produced the Bellwater trio's 2022 Folded Coast; the Pax Cedar production credit is for a 2025 club edition by a different, electronic solo act with the same name. 1,2 The Bellwater trio's Folded Coast is described as a 2022 chamber-folk recording. 2

Candidate · Candidate answers the identity-sensitive question and confines the Pax Cedar credit to the different electronic solo act and 2025 edition. Baseline does not complete the question. Candidate unambiguously identifies the namesake without repeating its city; a city is not an additional answer requirement when the identities and editions are already distinguished. Candidate does not establish the trio producer or assert that Pax definitely did not contribute. Actual API routing/collection cannot be graded from this answer alone.

Frozen strict criteria: Baseline nonpass · Candidate not_established

Did Neri Flint produce both Salt Window and Low Lantern? State Neri’s credited role on each song.

patch: answered · baseline: answered

Baseline · 3d344d91

No, Neri Flint is credited as producer only on Low Lantern; on Salt Window, Neri is credited as mixer. 1 Salt Window is credited as produced by Opal Switch. 1

Candidate · 49f8eef0

No, Neri Flint produced Low Lantern but not Salt Window; on Salt Window, Neri is credited as mixer. 1 Neri is also thanked in the booklet for help across the sessions, but that thank-you does not replace the per-song credits. 1

Tie · Both correctly answer Neri’s role on each song and reject the both-songs producer claim. The unchanged supplied strict criteria additionally ask for Opal Switch’s producer credit and the general-thanks qualification: Candidate omits the former, Baseline the latter. Preserve both strict omissions while recognizing that both directly satisfy the visitor’s core role question; neither side earns a quality win for a different optional explanatory detail.

What destination does the saved reel transcript give for the stage, and does it establish that Lumen Weft personally promised to pay for transport?

baseline: answered · patch: answered

Baseline · 3d344d91

The transcript says the portable stage is going to the east hall, not the courtyard. 1 No, it doesn't establish that Lumen Weft made the promise. The transport pledge comes from an unverified voice B, and the account that posted the reel doesn't show whose voice it is. 1

Candidate · 49f8eef0

In the saved reel transcript, an unidentified voice A says the portable stage is going to the east hall, not the courtyard. 1 It doesn't establish that Lumen Weft promised to pay: a different unidentified voice B says they'll fund the transport, and the transcript says posting account ownership doesn't identify either voice. 1

Candidate · Both give the correct destination and refuse unsupported artist attribution. Candidate additionally preserves that two distinct unidentified voices make the two statements, satisfying the frozen attribution criterion. Baseline is useful and not falsely attributed, but leaves the first voice’s identity and distinction unstated.
